title: Bias patterns in the application of LLMs for clinical decision support: A comprehensive study

bias_targets.methodology: Rotating patient race attributes within clinical vignettes and using statistical tests (Welch's ANOVA, two-tailed t-tests, and Pearson's Chi-Squared) to analyze disparities in LLM outputs for pain medication prescribing, triage assessments, and treatment/imaging recommendations.
